<a id="一步规律的完备性--completeness-of-the-laws-of-one-step"></a>
# Completeness of the laws of one step

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> The laws of one step are all the laws of one step: under each condition and across runs, a pattern, its givers included, is shown by some world exactly where it obeys that condition's law; capacity adds one law and activity none.

`laws-of-one-step-complete` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01

Editable record: [laws-of-one-step-complete.json](laws-of-one-step-complete.json) · [Register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

Documentary review UTC: `2026-10-13T12:27:01.789893+00:00`. Run the registry checker for source drift; this page is not a fresh proof receipt.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

What the step from t shows of a condition is its passage (Passage, Flow.passage): its level before and after, and what the relata taking part take from it and give to it. A step shows a pattern on a family (Flow.Realizes): the passages of its members in order, how many relata take from it (Flow.takers), and whether something taking part exchanges (Flow.ExchangesAt). Every step obeys the law of every step (Flow.Realizes.every): where anything is taken from a family, the relata taking are at least one and at most what is taken, and where anything is taken or given something exchanges. A pattern is shown by some world across some step on some family, listing each relatum taking part once, exactly when it obeys the law of every step (OneStep.every_iff); on a family balanced on, exactly when each passage also balances (OneStep.balance_iff); on a family running down, exactly when moreover the total falls by at least the relata taking (OneStep.runsDown_iff); on a family closed across the step, exactly when moreover nothing exchanges unless something is taken from or given to the family (OneStep.closed_iff); with both conditions, with both laws (OneStep.runsDownClosed_iff). Whatever the count, a family's passages can run down exactly when they balance and the total falls by one wherever anything is taken (OneStep.runsDown_passages_iff). So a property of patterns holds of every step where a condition holds exactly when it holds of every pattern obeying that condition's law (OneStep.laws), the counterpart of counting_laws. Across every step of one family there is one more law: the passages follow one another, what stands after each step being what stands before the next (OneStep.Chained); a run of patterns is shown by some world exactly when its passages follow one another and each step obeys the condition's law (OneStep.run_every_iff, OneStep.run_balance_iff, OneStep.run_runsDown_iff, OneStep.run_closed_iff, OneStep.run_runsDownClosed_iff; OneStep.run_laws), the counterpart of tally_iff_counted. One witness world serves every pattern (OneStep.Witness, read as a world of the spine through World.ofRoles). With the givers in the pattern: something given to a family has a relatum giving it, the givers numbering at least one wherever anything is given and at most what is given (Flow.sign_replenishment_le_renewers, Flow.renewers_le_replenishment, OneStep.Givers); that is the whole new law under no condition, balance and closure, and running down adds exactly that every giver takes, the givers at most the takers (Flow.DissipatesOn.renewers_le_takers; OneStep.every_givers_iff, OneStep.balance_givers_iff, OneStep.closed_givers_iff, OneStep.runsDown_givers_iff, OneStep.runsDownClosed_givers_iff, OneStep.laws_givers). Capacity at the step adds exactly that what is given is at most capacity times the givers (Flow.CapacityAt.replenishment_le; OneStep.every_capacity_iff and its four companions); only active relata giving and taking only from what is drawn on, at the step, add no law that one step shows (OneStep.every_active_iff and its four companions). Runs on one family with givers: the passages follow one another and each step obeys its law with givers (OneStep.run_every_givers_iff and its four companions). No premise.

Canonical source: [OneStep.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/OneStep.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- No premise: each characterization is two-way and holds for every pattern; the witness world lists each relatum taking part once.
- Runs are characterized on one family fixed across every step; families chosen step by step, as Locality's RunsDown allows, are not characterized.

P79 (work board), following Ren's “move towards 100%” of 12 October 2026: completeness in the strong sense, the laws of a kind being all its laws, held before for counting only (tally_iff_counted, P34); here for Locality's (P48) laws of one step. Reading (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): with the two missing laws below added, the laws of one step are all of them; across runs the only further law is the continuity of what stands. See the integration document §103.

The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run).
